description: This Kotlin source file defines an OrderRepository class responsible for managing order data in-memory, including placing orders and retrieving order history within a grocery app.

classes.name: OrderRepository
classes.description: Provides methods to place orders and retrieve order history, storing data in a mutable list.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Creates a string summary of the order with timestamp, mode, item details, total, and address, then adds it to the in-memory list.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Returns an immutable copy of the list of all placed orders.
